description: Trust Pyramid: block finishing a turn until scripts/check.sh passes.

hooks.command: if r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$r/scripts/stop-gate.sh" ]; then exec bash "$r/scripts/stop-gate.sh"; else echo '{"systemMessage": "trust-pyramid Stop hook: scripts/stop-gate.sh not found from the current directory, so the quality checks did not run."}'; fi
